messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Atorvastatin calcium belongs to a class of medications called HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors, commonly referred to as statins.
Atrovastatin tablets are taken once daily with or without food.

C. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
